response.overview: Ceren, trying to escape her past and build a new life for herself, returns to the village where she spent her childhood years later, only to encounter inexplicable events. With her arrival, the dark past that the village has silently hidden for so long awakens, and the curse thought to be forgotten begins to manifest itself. But the truth awaiting Ceren is far more shocking. Learning that she is the one they have been waiting for all these years, the young woman is drawn into the center of supernatural events that will change the fate of the town, along with an ancient seal that appears on her body. In this struggle surrounded by secrets from the past, curses that have lasted for generations, and unseen forces, Ceren must confront both her own destiny and the darkness that has held the village captive for centuries.
response.title: Azem 6: Mühür
